itens.titulo: uCreator Android Spyware Can Steal Telegram 2FA Passwords and Clone WeChat Accounts
itens.resumo: A rentable Android spyware kit called uCreator takes over Telegram and WeChat accounts by hiding its code inside working copies of the two apps, researcher Ovi found. itens.titulo: Two Critical Wasmtime Flaws Could Let Malicious WebAssembly Modules Escape Sandboxes
itens.resumo: Two critical flaws in Wasmtime, a WebAssembly runtime that can be built into other software, could allow a malicious WebAssembly module to escape the sandbox intended to contain it, the project's maintainers say. itens.titulo: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware
itens.resumo: A malicious instruction file sitting in a developer's Downloads folder tried to make their AI coding agent install a known-malicious npm package, security firm Forever Security said in a report published last week. itens.titulo: Unpatched Tailscale SSH Flaws Could Let a Hacked Device Reach Root on Other Servers
itens.resumo: A single hacked device on a Tailscale network can be used to gain root access to other servers it can reach, according to a security researcher who published the findings this week. The attack requires two things: Tailscale SSH set up to allow port forwarding, and an attacker who already controls one device that the network's access rules permit to connect to the target.
